import numpy as np

out = {}

# Example 1: issue boundary (single boundary element)
shape = (8194, 1)
indices_2d = np.arange(np.prod(shape), dtype=np.intp)[:, None]
flat = 8193
coords = np.unravel_index(np.array([flat], dtype=np.intp), shape)
# coords is a tuple of arrays
rt = np.ravel_multi_index(coords, shape)
out['issue_boundary_flat']=int(flat)
out['issue_boundary_coord_row']=int(coords[0][0])
out['issue_boundary_coord_col']=int(coords[1][0])
out['issue_boundary_roundtrip_flat']=int(rt[0])

# Example 2: buffered nditer remove_multi_index
a = np.arange(10).reshape(10, 1)
i = np.nditer(a, ['buffered', 'multi_index'], buffersize=5)
i.remove_multi_index()
i.enable_external_loop()

# Attempt to concatenate buffered chunks
chunks = [chunk.copy() for chunk in i]
try:
    concat = np.concatenate(chunks) if len(chunks) > 0 else np.array([], dtype=a.dtype)
    concat_ok = True
except Exception as e:
    concat_ok = False
    concat = None

out['nditer_buffered_dim']=int(getattr(i, 'ndim', -1))
out['nditer_concat_ok']=bool(concat_ok)
out['nditer_concat_values']=concat.tolist() if concat_ok else None
out['nditer_expected_ravel']=a.ravel().tolist()

# Example 3: 10k column-vector boundary sweep
indices = np.arange(10_000, dtype=np.intp)[:, None]
coords3 = np.unravel_index(indices, (100, 100))
rt3 = np.ravel_multi_index(coords3, (100, 100))
# find first failing index if any
fails = np.nonzero(rt3.reshape(-1) != indices.reshape(-1))[0]
out['bulk_10k_num_fails']=int(fails.size)
out['bulk_10k_first_fail_flat']=int(indices.reshape(-1)[fails[0]]) if fails.size else None
out['bulk_10k_first_fail_roundtrip']=int(rt3.reshape(-1)[fails[0]]) if fails.size else None

# also return boolean if strict equality holds
out['bulk_10k_equal']=bool(fails.size==0)

# Emit probes
for k,v in out.items():
    probe(k, v)

    shape = (8194, 1)
    indices_2d = np.arange(np.prod(shape), dtype=np.intp)[:, None]
    flat_index = 8193

    # Round-trip through unravel_index/ravel_multi_index
    unraveled = np.unravel_index(flat_index, shape)
    round_trip = np.ravel_multi_index(unraveled, shape)

    probe("indices_2d = np.arange(np.prod(shape), dtype=np.intp)[:, None] with shape=(8194,1); the element at flat-index position 8193 is fed through an np.unravel_index/ravel_multi_index round-trip.", round_trip)
except Exception as e:
    probe_exception(
        "indices_2d = np.arange(np.prod(shape), dtype=np.intp)[:, None] with shape=(8194,1); the element at flat-index position 8193 is fed through an np.unravel_index/ravel_multi_index round-trip.",
        e,
    )
